description: Antigravity (agy) as a long-running resident engine node — `r4t engine agy run --resident`, keeping one `stream-json` session alive while it works and for `TIMEOUT` seconds of quiet after the last turn (default 2700, 45 minutes), pushing new messages into the active conversation and wrapping up STATUS.md/LESSONS.md at expiry; the next message after that starts a fresh session from STATUS.md. `a8s stop`, `restart` and `kill` end the session at once through `stop.invoke`. Enable private K7E memory with `a8s vars <name> set MEMORY on`. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. Set the quiet window per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set EFFORT to an engine-supported reasoning level; unset uses the engine default. Commit as the agent with `a8s vars <name> set GIT_NAME ...` and `GIT_EMAIL ...`; unset uses git's own config.
